title: Don's Remembrance Day poppy suit

clothingReference.description: Original charcoal-black jacket printed with scarlet black-centred remembrance poppies and muted green leaves; burgundy-red tie. Owner request of 2026-11-09.

assets.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Production transparent character cutout, full untrimmed 1254 x 1254 square canvas. Input image is the EDIT TARGET: Don's normal default/listening pose. Change ONLY jacket fabric and tie into a special Remembrance Day suit. Jacket is rich charcoal-black cloth covered in a bold repeating pattern of vivid scarlet remembrance poppies with BLACK circular centres, organic rounded petals, a few understated dark green leaves; medium-large flowers distributed across torso, lapels and sleeves. Respectful and handsome, still Don's flamboyant printed tailoring. Deep burgundy-red silk tie with subtle tonal texture, no stripes. Preserve white shirt/cuffs and white pocket square, black lapel microphone, jacket cut and every pose/identity detail exactly: silver faceted robot face, cyan screen eyes, sculpted white hair, connected white moustache and broad goatee, stern CLOSED mouth seam, hands clasped low, shoulders, scale, margins, lower cutoff, facing slightly screen-right. Same crisp cel-shaded illustration, black outlines and silver shading. No medals, text, logos, additional lapel pin, desk, background, shadows outside silhouette or extra objects. Actual alpha transparency. Match input silhouette and head/hands pixel positions as closely as possible; do not zoom, crop, mirror, or redesign the robot.
